notes.title: Update Notes for June 18, Part Deux: Electric Boogaloo -- Final
notes.notes:
Fixed a long-standing bug that could softlock the game if the player died while moving through doors or between battles.

I apologize for the long delay with this issue. This bug was difficult to track down since it required almost frame-perfect precision and hundreds of attempts to reproduce, fix, and confirm.

Thank you for being so patient.

On another note, you can press ESC+D to generate a dump file (gamestate.dmp) if you encounter a game-breaking issue. The file will be located at c:\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\Graverobber Foundation\Dragon Ruins\, next to the logs and save files.

If you provide a dump along with the logs, this will make troubleshooting a lot easier in the future.

notes.title: Post-Release Plans
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just here to share that the game sold well and has met the minimum sales target, which means that localization and console ports are in the cards.

Which brings us to the following announcements:
[olist]
[*] Japanese localization is in development and is handled by Izumi Thorn.
[*] Ukrainian localization is in development.
[*] The PlayStation version will launch later this year.
[*] A sequel is possible in the future.
[/olist]
Thank you for supporting us,
--RS
